parsed.explanation: The quoted passage appears verbatim and labels Lemma D as proved. However, the write-up gives only the phrase “Proof via stabilization of minimal elements inside a fixed m (finite 2^m),” without defining the stabilization argument or proving either equality for all cases. Likewise, Theorem A and Lemmas A–C are merely summarized. Because grading is restricted to written arguments, the labels “proved” and one-line descriptions cannot substitute for proofs. This is fatal to any reliance on Lemma D or the asserted framework, although the write-up independently acknowledges that the full proof remains incomplete.
